trans-unit.source: Import Historical Exchange Rates from ECB - Setup
trans-unit.target: Import historiske valutakurser fra ECB - Setup

trans-unit.source: Specifies the European Central Bank URL used to download exchange rates for the last 90 days.
trans-unit.target: Angiver URL'en til Den Europæiske Centralbank, der bruges til at downloade valutakurser for de seneste 90 dage.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the European Central Bank URL used to download the complete historical archive of exchange rates from January 4, 1999 to present.
trans-unit.target: Angiver URL'en til Den Europæiske Centralbank, der bruges til at downloade det komplette historiske arkiv af valutakurser fra 4. januar 1999 til i dag.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the European Central Bank URL used to download the most recent daily exchange rates.
trans-unit.target: Angiver URL'en til Den Europæiske Centralbank, der bruges til at downloade de seneste daglige valutakurser.

trans-unit.source: Some features of this app require an active subscription.
trans-unit.target: Nogle funktioner i denne app kræver et aktivt abonnement.

trans-unit.source: Indicates whether your EOS subscription is currently active. An active subscription is required to import more than 10 days of historical exchange rates.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om dit EOS-abonnement i øjeblikket er aktivt. Et aktivt abonnement er påkrævet for at importere mere end 10 dages historiske valutakurser.

trans-unit.source: Shows the current status of your EOS subscription, including information about activation, expiration, or any issues.
trans-unit.target: Viser den aktuelle status for dit EOS-abonnement, herunder oplysninger om aktivering, udløb eller eventuelle problemer.

trans-unit.source: Displays the validity period of your EOS subscription, showing the start and end dates. Choose the AssistEdit button to manage your subscription.
trans-unit.target: Viser gyldighedsperioden for dit EOS-abonnement med start- og slutdato. Vælg knappen AssistEdit for at administrere dit abonnement.

trans-unit.source: Opens the subscription management page where you can activate or renew your EOS subscription to access advanced features.
trans-unit.target: Åbner abonnementsstyringssiden, hvor du kan aktivere eller forny dit EOS-abonnement for at få adgang til avancerede funktioner.

trans-unit.source: Import Historical Exchange Rates from ECB

trans-unit.target: Importeret med succes.\%1 %2 er blevet opdateret.

trans-unit.source: Using this option will download all exchange rates starting from january 04 1999. Only rates after starting date will be saved.\This may take several minutes.
trans-unit.target: Ved hjælp af denne indstilling downloades alle valutakurser fra januar 1999. Kun priser efter start vil blive gemt. \ Det kan tage flere minutter.

trans-unit.source: Local Currency Code is not specified in GL Setup.An ISO Code (USD,EUR...) is needed
trans-unit.target: Lokal valuta kode er ikke angivet i GL Setup.An ISO kode (USD, EUR ...) er nødvendig

trans-unit.source: Starting date cannot be later than today.
trans-unit.target: Startdato kan ikke være rivende end i dag.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the time range for importing exchange rates: Today (latest rates only), 90 days (last three months), or All (complete historical data from January 1999).
trans-unit.target: Angiver tidsintervallet for import af valutakurser: I dag (kun seneste kurser), 90 dage (sidste tre måneder) eller Alle (komplette historiske data fra januar 1999).

trans-unit.source: Opens the setup page to configure the ECB exchange rate URLs and subscription settings.
trans-unit.target: Åbner opsætningssiden for at konfigurere ECB-valutakurs-URL'er og abonnementsindstillinger.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the earliest date from which to import exchange rates. Rates will be imported from this date through today. Leave blank to import all available historical data.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den tidligste dato, hvorfra valutakurser skal importeres. Kurser importeres fra denne dato til i dag. Lad feltet stå tomt for at importere alle tilgængelige historiske data.

trans-unit.source: Launches the report to import historical currency exchange rates from the European Central Bank (ECB) for the selected currencies. You can choose to import today's rates, the last 90 days, or the complete historical archive.
trans-unit.target: Starter rapporten for at importere historiske valutakurser fra Den Europæiske Centralbank (ECB) for de valgte valutaer. Du kan vælge at importere dagens kurser, de seneste 90 dage eller det komplette historiske arkiv.
